interface.longDescription: Run single-purpose SEO, AEO and GEO checks on any public website, then apply the ranked fixes and re-run to verify. Covers indexing, robots.txt and AI crawlers, structured data, rendering, Core Web Vitals, llms.txt and AI answer visibility.
